description:
LogoMakr is an easy-to-use online logo maker that enables users to design and customize logos quickly with a simple drag-and-drop interface and a vast icon library. It's ideal for small businesses and individuals seeking affordable branding solutions.

Custom logo maker and logo design tool. Create a 100% original logo with AI, then refine it on our full design canvas. Own your files. 300k+ businesses.

Drag-and-Drop Editor: Quickly assemble and customize logos. Icon Library: Access thousands of shapes and graphics. Font Selection: Choose from a range of typefaces. Unlimited Downloads: Export in web and print formats.
